bullets.text: On-Device Identity Verification - **TruSources** showcases tech for secure identity checks without data leaving your device.
Ad-Free Subscriptions Launch - **Meta** introduces paid subscriptions for **Facebook** and **Instagram** in the UK, reducing ad reliance.
Pixel Call Recording Returns - **Google** tests full call recording feature on **Pixel** devices in the UK and US.
AI Hosts in YouTube Music - **YouTube** tests AI hosts providing trivia and commentary for a richer music experience.
Raleigh One E-Bike Review - The **Raleigh One** offers a simpler design with essential features for urban commuting.
AI Data Center Investments - Massive funding continues in AI infrastructure, with **OpenAI** and **Nvidia** leading the charge.
Checkout.com Valuation Update - **Checkout.com** reaches a $12 billion valuation amid a turbulent investment landscape.
Humanoid Robot Skepticism - Renowned roboticist warns that the humanoid robot bubble may soon burst, calling it fantasy.
